_comment: PROJECT-3. The folders that sit beside runs in the store and are NOT runs. The service walks the store (Get-VmfFacadeRunIds) and so does the browser (listRunsAcrossProjects, and the overview's own load). Both must agree, or one of them reports a run that is not there. `vmf-claims` is the claim registry at the container root. `logs` is written by the product itself: an event recorded against a path that holds no run leaves one beside the runs, and the retention pass did exactly that on a lab install on 2026-09-16 before PROJECT-2 shipped. The folder it left is permanent, so the rule has to be permanent too.

cases.why: the claim registry at the container root
an event log, never a run
the same folder one level down, beside a project's runs
the NAME is matched whole, never as a prefix
the rule is the folder name, at any level
ATTEST-1: the migration records, kept beside the runs so a delete cannot take them
